notes:
Audit Suite overhaul:

• Fixed the root cause of "Balance Sheet does not tally" appearing even when Tally itself is balanced — the app was only matching a ledger's immediate parent group, so anything under a custom/nested sub-group silently dropped out of the totals. Now walks the full Tally group ancestry.
• Same fix applied across Ageing, Exceptions, Clause 44, Depreciation and Section 43B.
• New: Clause 27 (ITC/CENVAT credit availed, utilised, outstanding + prior-period items) — its own tab, KPI summary, and export.
• Redesigned the Engagement Detail screen: icon tabs, status-pill balance sheet banner, KPI strips.
• Excel exports are now premium-branded (navy/gold fills, zebra rows, gold totals) instead of plain black-and-white, plus a new "Export this report" button on every tab for a standalone single-report file.

Note: re-run "Pull from Tally" on existing engagements to get the corrected classification.
